verdict.rationale: Yapily is a SaaS open-banking platform that processes customers' financial data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The evidence pack contains no AI-training policy, opt-out control, or data-use commitment. Its consent and authorisation flows govern bank data access, which is an adjacent control, and its MCP and llms.txt docs access concerns agents reading documentation; neither addresses training-data use.
